name: Uppercase
description: Convert the filename to uppercase, Example: Report.pdf -> REPORT.pdf

name: Lowercase
description: Convert the filename to lowercase. Example: Report.pdf -> report.pdf

name: Title Case
description: Convert the filename to Title Case. Example: hello world.txt -> Hello World.txt

name: Capitalize
description: Convert the filename to Title Case. Example: report.docx -> Report.docx

name: affixes
description: Add prefix and suffix to the filename e.g: PREFIX_data_SUFFIX.txt

name: Replace
description: Search a text in the filename and let it replaced with the replace input.

name: Windows Style
description: Rename files exactly like Windows Explorer. Uses Windows Explorer-style duplicate naming (file (2).txt, file (3).txt, ...). Avoids filename collisions within the same directory.
